column1: # Process names that change the meaning of a listening port.
# When ss/netstat/lsof output names the owning process, the port finding picks up the
# description below. A severity of NOTICE or worse also raises the finding to at least
# that level - a normal port served by netcat is not a normal port.
# severity  OK | INFO | NOTICE | WARN | CRITICAL   (OK/INFO only annotate, never escalate)
